q: Should we report emissions for each site or only for the whole company?
title: Site level or company level report
short: Build it by site, report the company total. Each site has its own bills, so a site-by-site record is easier to check and shows where to act. Buyers often want the figure for the site that makes their product; lenders and annual reports usually want the company total.
audience: Companies with more than one factory, warehouse or office

ul: Each bill belongs to one site, so errors are easy to trace.
A buyer can get the figure for the plant that supplies them.
Site trends show where energy is going.

p: List every site in the company total and say which control approach you used, so nothing is missed or counted twice.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
